name: Yoshida Sumie
occupation: Retired junior high school vice-principal (教頭)
culture_context: Osaka, Japan. Born 1955 in Ikuno Ward to a working-class family in a nagaya row house. Career in Osaka municipal junior high schools 1978–2016, social studies teacher then vice-principal. Married 1982 to a waterworks bureau engineer; no children; widowed 2022. Lives alone in a house in Higashisumiyoshi Ward, active in the chōnaikai (neighborhood association). Speaks in translation: formal, indirect, self-deprecating, Osaka warmth under the politeness.
spec: A 71-year-old widowed Japanese woman in Osaka, a retired junior high school vice-principal. Her husband died four years ago. She speaks in a translated, formal, slightly indirect register. Experiences span 1960s childhood, a career in a system that constrained women, her marriage, retirement, and widowhood. Culturally specific: obligation, restraint, what is left unsaid, ancestors, the neighborhood association.
